question: Where should the page icons go? Round 1 answer: "D is clean but also C has some nice two tiers approach and bar with x of y answered", and D's icons "look good but seems like here is a bad place for them cuz they are tooo small". All three keep D's breadcrumb with the round menu and C's round bar (arrows, question, 9 of 14 answered). Only the page nav (Compare, Library, Theme, History) moves. Click the pages and check light and dark.

variants.label: Icons with labels
variants.changes: Top bar keeps the pages on the right, as normal-size buttons with an icon and its name. The active page is filled. Tests whether words fix "too small" while the icons stay in the header.

variants.label: Bigger icons
variants.changes: D's icon-only toggle group, but larger: 40px tall items with 20px icons in a 56px top bar, names in tooltips, bigger theme toggle. Tests whether size alone was the problem.

variants.label: Side rail
variants.changes: Pages leave the header for a 72px rail on the left of the page: 20px icon with a small name under it, theme toggle at the bottom of the rail. The header holds only the breadcrumb and the round bar. Tests "bad place for them": the icons move out of the header.
